_header: Traditional public-domain Tanakh and prayer texts, assembled for review. Not clergy-reviewed. Pointed Hebrew and existing English copied verbatim; no new Hebrew composition, re-pointing or edits. Modeh Ani is supplied verbatim by the project brief, with pre-1929 siddur collation pending. English biblical renderings: JPS 1917 (public domain). Some verses from the existing ALEF morning corpus require external collation before a VERIFIED editorial mark.

prayers.he: מוֹדֶה אֲנִי לְפָנֶיךָ מֶלֶךְ חַי וְקַיָּם, שֶׁהֶחֱזַרְתָּ בִּי נִשְׁמָתִי בְּחֶמְלָה. רַבָּה אֱמוּנָתֶךָ
prayers.en: I thank You, living and eternal King, for returning my soul to me with compassion. Great is Your faithfulness.
prayers.source: Traditional Modeh Ani; exact Hebrew and English supplied in the 2026-11-06 ALEF homepage brief (independent pre-1929 siddur collation pending).

prayers.he: יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהוָה וְיִשְׁמְרֶךָ׃
prayers.en: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee;
prayers.source: Unicode/XML Leningrad Codex (UXLC) 2.6: Numbers 6:24 (copied verbatim from ALEF data/corpus/registry.json; https://tanach.us/Books/Numbers.xml). English: JPS 1917, public domain.

prayers.he: יָאֵר יְהוָה פָּנָיו אֵלֶיךָ וִיחֻנֶּךָּ׃
prayers.en: The LORD make His face to shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee;
prayers.source: Unicode/XML Leningrad Codex (UXLC) 2.6: Numbers 6:25 (copied verbatim from ALEF data/corpus/registry.json; https://tanach.us/Books/Numbers.xml). English: JPS 1917, public domain.

prayers.he: יִשָּׂא יְהוָה פָּנָיו אֵלֶיךָ וְיָשֵׂם לְךָ שָׁלוֹם׃
prayers.en: The LORD lift up His countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.
prayers.source: Unicode/XML Leningrad Codex (UXLC) 2.6: Numbers 6:26 (copied verbatim from ALEF data/corpus/registry.json; https://tanach.us/Books/Numbers.xml). English: JPS 1917, public domain.

prayers.he: שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ יְהוָה אֶחָד׃
prayers.en: HEAR, O ISRAEL: THE LORD OUR GOD, THE LORD IS ONE.
prayers.source: Unicode/XML Leningrad Codex (UXLC) 2.6: Deuteronomy 6:4 (copied verbatim from ALEF data/corpus/registry.json; https://tanach.us/Books/Deuteronomy.xml). English: JPS 1917, public domain.

prayers.he: וְאָהַבְתָּ אֵת יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכָל־לְבָבְךָ וּבְכָל־נַפְשְׁךָ וּבְכָל־מְאֹדֶךָ׃
prayers.en: And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.
prayers.source: Unicode/XML Leningrad Codex (UXLC) 2.6: Deuteronomy 6:5 (copied verbatim from ALEF data/corpus/registry.json; https://tanach.us/Books/Deuteronomy.xml). English: JPS 1917, public domain.

prayers.he: מַה־טֹּבוּ אֹהָלֶיךָ יַעֲקֹב מִשְׁכְּנֹתֶיךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
prayers.en: How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob, Thy dwellings, O Israel!
prayers.source: Unicode/XML Leningrad Codex (UXLC) 2.6: Numbers 24:5 (copied verbatim from ALEF data/corpus/registry.json; https://tanach.us/Books/Numbers.xml). English: JPS 1917, public domain.

prayers.he: מִי־כָמֹכָה בָּאֵלִם יְהוָה מִי כָּמֹכָה נֶאְדָּר בַּקֹּדֶשׁ נוֹרָא תְהִלֹּת עֹשֵׂה פֶלֶא׃
prayers.en: Who is like unto Thee, O LORD, among the mighty? Who is like unto Thee, glorious in holiness, Fearful in praises, doing wonders?
prayers.source: Unicode/XML Leningrad Codex (UXLC) 2.6: Exodus 15:11 (copied verbatim from ALEF data/corpus/registry.json; https://tanach.us/Books/Exodus.xml). English: JPS 1917, public domain.

prayers.he: אֵין־כָּמוֹךָ בָאֱלֹהִים אֲדֹנָי וְאֵין כְּמַעֲשֶׂיךָ׃
prayers.en: There is none like unto Thee among the gods, O Lord, And there are no works like Thine.
prayers.source: Unicode/XML Leningrad Codex (UXLC) 2.6: Psalm 86:8 (copied verbatim from ALEF data/corpus/registry.json; https://tanach.us/Books/Psalms.xml). English: JPS 1917, public domain.

prayers.he: מַלְכוּתְךָ מַלְכוּת כָּל־עֹלָמִים וּמֶמְשֶׁלְתְּךָ בְּכָל־דּוֹר וָדוֹר׃
prayers.en: Thy kingdom is a kingdom for all ages, And Thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.
prayers.source: Unicode/XML Leningrad Codex (UXLC) 2.6: Psalm 145:13 (copied verbatim from ALEF data/corpus/registry.json; https://tanach.us/Books/Psalms.xml). English: JPS 1917, public domain.

prayers.he: יְהוָה עֹז לְעַמּוֹ יִתֵּן יְהוָה יְבָרֵךְ אֶת־עַמּוֹ בַשָּׁלוֹם׃
prayers.en: The LORD will give strength unto His people; The LORD will bless his people with peace.
prayers.source: Unicode/XML Leningrad Codex (UXLC) 2.6: Psalm 29:11 (copied verbatim from ALEF data/corpus/registry.json; https://tanach.us/Books/Psalms.xml). English: JPS 1917, public domain.

prayers.he: גַּדְּלוּ לַיהוָה אִתִּי וּנְרוֹמְמָה שְׁמוֹ יַחְדָּו׃
prayers.en: O magnify the LORD with me, And let us exalt His name together.
prayers.source: Unicode/XML Leningrad Codex (UXLC) 2.6: Psalm 34:4 (copied verbatim from ALEF data/corpus/registry.json; https://tanach.us/Books/Psalms.xml). English: JPS 1917, public domain.

prayers.he: הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ יְהוָה אֵלֶיךָ וְנָשׁוּבָה חַדֵּשׁ יָמֵינוּ כְּקֶדֶם׃
prayers.en: Turn Thou us unto Thee, O LORD, and we shall be turned; Renew our days as of old.
prayers.source: Unicode/XML Leningrad Codex (UXLC) 2.6: Lamentations 5:21 (copied verbatim from ALEF data/corpus/registry.json; https://tanach.us/Books/Lamentations.xml). English: JPS 1917, public domain.

prayers.he: וְקָרָא זֶה אֶל־זֶה וְאָמַר קָדוֹשׁ קָדוֹשׁ קָדוֹשׁ יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת מְלֹא כָל־הָאָרֶץ כְּבוֹדוֹ׃
prayers.en: And one called unto another, and said: Holy, holy, holy, is the LORD of hosts; The whole earth is full of His glory.
prayers.source: Unicode/XML Leningrad Codex (UXLC) 2.6: Isaiah 6:3 (copied verbatim from ALEF data/corpus/registry.json; https://tanach.us/Books/Isaiah.xml). English: JPS 1917, public domain.

prayers.he: יִמְלֹךְ יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם אֱלֹהַיִךְ צִיּוֹן לְדֹר וָדֹר הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
prayers.en: The LORD will reign for ever, Thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Hallelujah.
prayers.source: Unicode/XML Leningrad Codex (UXLC) 2.6: Psalm 146:10 (copied verbatim from ALEF data/corpus/registry.json; https://tanach.us/Books/Psalms.xml). English: JPS 1917, public domain.

prayers.he: אַשְׁרֵי יוֹשְׁבֵי בֵיתֶךָ עוֹד יְהַלְלוּךָ סֶּלָה׃
prayers.en: Happy are they that dwell in Thy house, they are ever praising Thee. Selah
prayers.source: Unicode/XML Leningrad Codex (UXLC) 2.6: Psalm 84:5 (copied verbatim from ALEF data/corpus/registry.json; https://tanach.us/Books/Psalms.xml). English: JPS 1917, public domain.

prayers.he: אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם שֶׁכָּכָה לּוֹ אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם שֶׁיֲהוָה אֱלֹהָיו׃
prayers.en: Happy is the people that is in such a case. Yea, happy is the people whose God is the LORD.
prayers.source: Unicode/XML Leningrad Codex (UXLC) 2.6: Psalm 144:15 (copied verbatim from ALEF data/corpus/registry.json; https://tanach.us/Books/Psalms.xml). English: JPS 1917, public domain.

prayers.he: פּוֹתֵחַ אֶת־יָדֶךָ וּמַשְׂבִּיעַ לְכָל־חַי רָצוֹן׃
prayers.en: Thou openest Thy hand, And satisfiest every living thing with favour.
prayers.source: Unicode/XML Leningrad Codex (UXLC) 2.6: Psalm 145:16 (copied verbatim from ALEF data/corpus/registry.json; https://tanach.us/Books/Psalms.xml). English: JPS 1917, public domain.

prayers.he: שִׁוִּיתִי יְהוָה לְנֶגְדִּי תָמִיד כִּי מִימִינִי בַּל־אֶמּוֹט׃
prayers.en: I have set the LORD always before me; Surely He is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
prayers.source: ALEF data/morning-verses.json, Psalms 16:8 (pointed Hebrew from existing project corpus; English: JPS 1917, public domain; external source collation pending).

prayers.he: יִהְיוּ־לְרָצוֹן אִמְרֵי־פִי וְהֶגְיוֹן לִבִּי לְפָנֶיךָ יְהוָה צוּרִי וְגֹאֲלִי׃
prayers.en: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable before Thee, O LORD, my Rock, and my Redeemer.
prayers.source: ALEF data/morning-verses.json, Psalms 19:15 (pointed Hebrew from existing project corpus; English: JPS 1917, public domain; external source collation pending).

prayers.he: גַּם כִּי־אֵלֵךְ בְּגֵיא צַלְמָוֶת לֹא־אִירָא רָע כִּי־אַתָּה עִמָּדִי שִׁבְטְךָ וּמִשְׁעַנְתֶּךָ הֵמָּה יְנַחֲמֻנִי׃
prayers.en: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for Thou art with me; Thy rod and Thy staff, they comfort me.
prayers.source: ALEF data/morning-verses.json, Psalms 23:4 (pointed Hebrew from existing project corpus; English: JPS 1917, public domain; external source collation pending).

prayers.he: אַחַת שָׁאַלְתִּי מֵאֵת־יְהוָה אוֹתָהּ אֲבַקֵּשׁ שִׁבְתִּי בְּבֵית־יְהוָה כָּל־יְמֵי חַיַּי לַחֲזוֹת בְּנֹעַם־יְהוָה וּלְבַקֵּר בְּהֵיכָלוֹ׃
prayers.en: One thing have I asked of the LORD, that will I seek after: That I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, To behold the graciousness of the LORD, and to visit early in His temple.
prayers.source: ALEF data/morning-verses.json, Psalms 27:4 (pointed Hebrew from existing project corpus; English: JPS 1917, public domain; external source collation pending).

prayers.he: קַוֵּה אֶל־יְהוָה חֲזַק וְיַאֲמֵץ לִבֶּךָ וְקַוֵּה אֶל־יְהוָה׃
prayers.en: Wait on the LORD; Be strong, and let thy heart take courage; Yea, wait thou for the LORD.
prayers.source: ALEF data/morning-verses.json, Psalms 27:14 (pointed Hebrew from existing project corpus; English: JPS 1917, public domain; external source collation pending).

prayers.he: כִּי רֶגַע בְּאַפּוֹ חַיִּים בִּרְצוֹנוֹ בָּעֶרֶב יָלִין בֶּכִי וְלַבֹּקֶר רִנָּה׃
prayers.en: For His anger is but for a moment, His favour is for a life-time; weeping may tarry for the night, but joy cometh in the morning.
prayers.source: ALEF data/morning-verses.json, Psalms 30:6 (pointed Hebrew from existing project corpus; English: JPS 1917, public domain; external source collation pending).

prayers.he: טַעֲמוּ וּרְאוּ כִּי־טוֹב יְהוָה אַשְׁרֵי הַגֶּבֶר יֶחֱסֶה־בּוֹ׃
prayers.en: O consider and see that the LORD is good; Happy is the man that taketh refuge in Him.
prayers.source: ALEF data/morning-verses.json, Psalms 34:9 (pointed Hebrew from existing project corpus; English: JPS 1917, public domain; external source collation pending).

prayers.he: סוּר מֵרָע וַעֲשֵׂה־טוֹב בַּקֵּשׁ שָׁלוֹם וְרָדְפֵהוּ׃
prayers.en: Depart from evil, and do good; Seek peace, and pursue it.
prayers.source: ALEF data/morning-verses.json, Psalms 34:15 (pointed Hebrew from existing project corpus; English: JPS 1917, public domain; external source collation pending).

prayers.he: בְּטַח בַּיהוָה וַעֲשֵׂה־טוֹב שְׁכָן־אֶרֶץ וּרְעֵה אֱמוּנָה׃
prayers.en: Trust in the LORD, and do good; dwell in the land, and cherish faithfulness.
prayers.source: ALEF data/morning-verses.json, Psalms 37:3 (pointed Hebrew from existing project corpus; English: JPS 1917, public domain; external source collation pending).

prayers.he: אֱלֹהִים לָנוּ מַחֲסֶה וָעֹז עֶזְרָה בְצָרוֹת נִמְצָא מְאֹד׃
prayers.en: God is our refuge and strength, A very present help in trouble.
prayers.source: ALEF data/morning-verses.json, Psalms 46:2 (pointed Hebrew from existing project corpus; English: JPS 1917, public domain; external source collation pending).

prayers.he: הַרְפּוּ וּדְעוּ כִּי־אָנֹכִי אֱלֹהִים אָרוּם בַּגּוֹיִם אָרוּם בָּאָרֶץ׃
prayers.en: 'Let be, and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.'
prayers.source: ALEF data/morning-verses.json, Psalms 46:11 (pointed Hebrew from existing project corpus; English: JPS 1917, public domain; external source collation pending).

prayers.he: לֵב טָהוֹר בְּרָא־לִי אֱלֹהִים וְרוּחַ נָכוֹן חַדֵּשׁ בְּקִרְבִּי׃
prayers.en: Create me a clean heart, O God; and renew a stedfast spirit within me.
prayers.source: ALEF data/morning-verses.json, Psalms 51:12 (pointed Hebrew from existing project corpus; English: JPS 1917, public domain; external source collation pending).

prayers.he: הַשְׁלֵךְ עַל־יְהוָה יְהָבְךָ וְהוּא יְכַלְכְּלֶךָ לֹא־יִתֵּן לְעוֹלָם מוֹט לַצַּדִּיק׃
prayers.en: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and He will sustain thee; He will never suffer the righteous to be moved.
prayers.source: ALEF data/morning-verses.json, Psalms 55:23 (pointed Hebrew from existing project corpus; English: JPS 1917, public domain; external source collation pending).

prayers.he: לִמְנוֹת יָמֵינוּ כֵּן הוֹדַע וְנָבִא לְבַב חָכְמָה׃
prayers.en: So teach us to number our days, That we may get us a heart of wisdom.
prayers.source: ALEF data/morning-verses.json, Psalms 90:12 (pointed Hebrew from existing project corpus; English: JPS 1917, public domain; external source collation pending).

prayers.he: יֹשֵׁב בְּסֵתֶר עֶלְיוֹן בְּצֵל שַׁדַּי יִתְלוֹנָן׃
prayers.en: O thou that dwellest in the covert of the Most High, And abidest in the shadow of the Almighty;
prayers.source: ALEF data/morning-verses.json, Psalms 91:1 (pointed Hebrew from existing project corpus; English: JPS 1917, public domain; external source collation pending).

prayers.he: טוֹב לְהֹדוֹת לַיהוָה וּלְזַמֵּר לְשִׁמְךָ עֶלְיוֹן׃
prayers.en: It is a good thing to give thanks unto the LORD, And to sing praises unto Thy name, O Most High;
prayers.source: ALEF data/morning-verses.json, Psalms 92:2 (pointed Hebrew from existing project corpus; English: JPS 1917, public domain; external source collation pending).

prayers.he: עִבְדוּ אֶת־יְהוָה בְּשִׂמְחָה בֹּאוּ לְפָנָיו בִּרְנָנָה׃
prayers.en: Serve the LORD with gladness; come before His presence with singing.
prayers.source: ALEF data/morning-verses.json, Psalms 100:2 (pointed Hebrew from existing project corpus; English: JPS 1917, public domain; external source collation pending).

prayers.he: כִּי־טוֹב יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ וְעַד־דֹּר וָדֹר אֱמוּנָתוֹ׃
prayers.en: For the LORD is good; His mercy endureth for ever; and His faithfulness unto all generations.
prayers.source: ALEF data/morning-verses.json, Psalms 100:5 (pointed Hebrew from existing project corpus; English: JPS 1917, public domain; external source collation pending).

prayers.he: רֵאשִׁית חָכְמָה יִרְאַת יְהוָה שֵׂכֶל טוֹב לְכָל־עֹשֵׂיהֶם תְּהִלָּתוֹ עֹמֶדֶת לָעַד׃
prayers.en: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; A good understanding have all they that do thereafter; His praise endureth for ever.
prayers.source: ALEF data/morning-verses.json, Psalms 111:10 (pointed Hebrew from existing project corpus; English: JPS 1917, public domain; external source collation pending).

prayers.he: הוֹדוּ לַיהוָה כִּי־טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
prayers.en: 'O give thanks unto the LORD, for He is good, For His mercy endureth for ever.
prayers.source: ALEF data/morning-verses.json, Psalms 118:1 (pointed Hebrew from existing project corpus; English: JPS 1917, public domain; external source collation pending).

prayers.he: זֶה־הַיּוֹם עָשָׂה יְהוָה נָגִילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָה בוֹ׃
prayers.en: This is the day which the LORD hath made; We will rejoice and be glad in it.
prayers.source: ALEF data/morning-verses.json, Psalms 118:24 (pointed Hebrew from existing project corpus; English: JPS 1917, public domain; external source collation pending).

prayers.he: עֶזְרִי מֵעִם יְהוָה עֹשֵׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ׃
prayers.en: My help cometh from the LORD, Who made heaven and earth.
prayers.source: ALEF data/morning-verses.json, Psalms 121:2 (pointed Hebrew from existing project corpus; English: JPS 1917, public domain; external source collation pending).

prayers.he: יְהוָה יִשְׁמָר־צֵאתְךָ וּבוֹאֶךָ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם׃
prayers.en: The LORD shall guard thy going out and thy coming in, From this time forth and for ever.
prayers.source: ALEF data/morning-verses.json, Psalms 121:8 (pointed Hebrew from existing project corpus; English: JPS 1917, public domain; external source collation pending).

prayers.he: הַזֹּרְעִים בְּדִמְעָה בְּרִנָּה יִקְצֹרוּ׃
prayers.en: They that sow in tears Shall reap in joy.
prayers.source: ALEF data/morning-verses.json, Psalms 126:5 (pointed Hebrew from existing project corpus; English: JPS 1917, public domain; external source collation pending).

prayers.he: אוֹדְךָ עַל כִּי נוֹרָאוֹת נִפְלֵיתִי נִפְלָאִים מַעֲשֶׂיךָ וְנַפְשִׁי יֹדַעַת מְאֹד׃
prayers.en: I will give thanks unto Thee, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made; Wonderful are Thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.
prayers.source: ALEF data/morning-verses.json, Psalms 139:14 (pointed Hebrew from existing project corpus; English: JPS 1917, public domain; external source collation pending).

prayers.he: טוֹב־יְהוָה לַכֹּל וְרַחֲמָיו עַל־כָּל־מַעֲשָׂיו׃
